title: Raj Sisodia, author of Conscious Capitalism — 'Eric Ries's exceptional and essential book'
summary: Raj Sisodia, who co-founded the Conscious Capitalism movement and has written sixteen books on purpose-driven business, tells his field to read it. He frames the book not as adjacent reading but as required: lessons a conscious capitalist is meant to apply, not just admire.
blockquote: Eric Ries's exceptional and essential book "Incorruptible" is currently available for $1.99 on Kindle. Every practicing and aspiring Conscious Capitalist should read this book and apply its lessons.
attribution_title: Author, Conscious Capitalism · FEMSA Distinguished University Professor of Conscious Enterprise, Tecnológico de Monterrey
